entries.title: II Chronicles 27:1
segments: Jotham [was] twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:2
segments: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did. Only, he did not enter into the temple of the LORD. And the people still did evilly.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:3
segments: He built the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:4
segments: And he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built palaces and towers.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:5
segments: And He fought with the king of the Ammonites and prevailed over them. And the sons of Ammon gave him the same year a hundred talents of silver and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. This the sons of Ammon paid to him, both the second year and the third.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:6
segments: And Jotham became mighty because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:7
segments: And the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they [are] written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:8
segments: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:9
segments: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And his son Ahaz reigned in his place.
